sights.note: rear aperture centre / front post tip: first estimate; refined on the rig

note: Modern submachine gun (CZ Scorpion EVO 3 A1, 9 mm, 30-round magazine, auto / semi). Modern weapons case only.

model.credit: supplied by the user (incoming/modern_guns/scorpion-first-person-animations-2026-remake); redistribution allowed (confirmed by the user 2026-11-14, docs/credits.md)

points.note: WP2: measured on the rig at the idle pose by rendering along the line: rear = the aperture ring's centre, front = the tip of the centre post between the two protective ears (the old front point sat on top of the right ear); up = the gun's vertical (the idle clip rolls it 1.25 deg). The model's ring sits about 4.5 mm right of the post's plane, so the line runs 1.6 deg off the bore; aimed rounds follow the line (MG8).
